skill.name: competitor-tracker
skill.description: Track competitor influencer partnerships, campaigns, content formats, estimated performance, and strategy gaps. Use public or user-provided data to produce a sourced comparison report.
skill.summary: Build structured competitor influencer benchmarks and identify ranked opportunities.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, relative documentation links, connector labels, and metadata URLs. Two command recipes are confirmed because they execute local Python connectors with user-supplied placeholders; the channel handle is unquoted and can permit shell injection. No prompt injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The YouTube connector command places a user-provided channel handle directly into shell text without quoting.
remediation.suggestion: Invoke the connector with a structured argument array, or restrict handles to a documented safe character set before execution.

remediation.issue: The GDELT command interpolates a user-provided competitor query into a shell command.
remediation.suggestion: Pass the query as a separate process argument and avoid shell evaluation. Validate length and accepted characters before invocation.

remediation.issue: The command recipes depend on connector scripts outside the audited skill files.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed connector code or reference a pinned, integrity-checked dependency so users can audit the executed implementation.

content.value_statement: Competitor influencer activity is difficult to compare across creators, platforms, and campaigns. This skill builds a structured benchmark with estimates, sources, gaps, and ranked opportunities.
actual_capabilities: Builds a current or recent influencer partnership roster for each competitor.
Organizes creators by platform, follower tier, relationship type, and collaboration duration.
Analyzes campaign timing, content formats, messaging, calls to action, and estimated spend.
Estimates reach, engagement, earned media value, and performance by platform or creator tier.
Compares your brand with competitors in side-by-side strategy and share-of-voice tables.
Ranks untapped creators, former competitor partners, platform gaps, and content opportunities.
limitations: Results depend on public information, user-provided data, and any available connectors.
Reach, engagement, spend, and earned media value may be estimates rather than verified figures.
The skill cannot access private contracts, internal campaign results, or restricted platform data.
It does not perform full creator discovery or brand-fit scoring.

use_cases.title: Benchmark a Brand Category
use_cases.description: Compare several competitors across partner tiers, platforms, campaign cadence, content formats, and estimated performance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Campaign Strategy
use_cases.description: Find underused platforms, creator segments, themes, and formats before planning a differentiated campaign.

use_cases.title: Monitor Market Changes
use_cases.description: Track recurring partnerships, new launches, creator movement, and shifts in competitor investment over time.

prompt_templates.title: Track One Competitor
prompt_templates.prompt: Track [competitor] influencer activity on [platform] during [time period]. List recent partners, campaign themes, content formats, and clearly labeled estimates.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [competitor 1], [competitor 2], and [competitor 3] across creator tiers, platforms, campaign frequency, content strategy, and estimated performance.

prompt_templates.title: Find Strategic Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [competitors] in [category]. Rank at least three creator, platform, niche, or content gaps that [your brand] can pursue.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Monitoring Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sourced competitor influencer report for [period]. Separate observed facts from estimates, compare changes over time, and recommend immediate and quarterly actions.

output_examples.input: Track one skincare competitor on Instagram for the last 90 days.
output: A roster of observed creator partners with partnership type and posting cadence.
A campaign timeline covering themes, formats, calls to action, and labeled performance estimates.
Three ranked gaps with evidence and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Compare three beverage brands across TikTok and YouTube.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side benchmark summarizes creator tiers, platform activity, content formats, engagement estimates, and share of voice. It highlights underused niches and formats.

output_examples.input: Review competitor strategy changes between two quarters.
output_examples.output: The report separates persistent patterns from new activity, identifies partner and campaign changes, and recommends monitoring priorities for the next quarter.

best_practices: Provide exact competitor names, platforms, date ranges, and known creator handles.
Require sources for observed facts and label every calculated or inferred figure as an estimate.
Repeat the analysis on a fixed schedule so changes in partnerships and campaign cadence remain visible.
anti_patterns: Do not present estimated spend, reach, or engagement as verified internal data.
Do not infer exclusivity or contract terms from a single sponsored post.
Do not compare competitors across different periods without explaining the mismatch.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your brand, competitor names, platforms, date range, focus areas, and any creator handles you already know.

faq.question: Can the skill work without paid data tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use public posts and user-provided information, but coverage and metric accuracy may be limited.

faq.question: Are performance figures verified?
faq.answer: Not always. The skill labels inferred reach, engagement, spend, and earned media value as estimates.

faq.question: Does it find creators for my brand?
faq.answer: It identifies competitor gaps and possible former partners. Full discovery and fit scoring require dedicated creator research.

faq.question: How many competitors can I compare?
faq.answer: The templates support several competitors. Smaller sets usually allow deeper evidence review and clearer comparisons.

faq.question: How often should I repeat the analysis?
faq.answer: Use a monthly or quarterly schedule based on campaign frequency. Keep each comparison period consistent.
